summary: RAPTOR is an autonomous offensive/defensive security-research harness that is "Based on Claude Code": bin/raptor is a hardened bash launcher that ultimately execs the Anthropic `claude` CLI (pinned in the repo's devcontainer to @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.269), and the startup banner confirms Claude Code is RAPTOR's model transport ("llm: no external LLM configured / claude code ✓"). RAPTOR's own launcher only starts an INTERACTIVE session (it forces the `/raptor` initial prompt and never exits on its own), so it is unsuitable for one-shot non-interactive execution; the harness's real model-calling engine is the `claude` CLI itself. We therefore run Claude Code in headless mode (`claude -p "$TASK"`), which reads/edits files in the current working directory, makes all model calls to the Anthropic Messages API at $ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/v1/messages, and exits when the task is done. The overlay installs Node + Claude Code self-contained under /opt/harness (never touching the base image's toolchain) and copies the RAPTOR sources alongside it.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=buildpack-deps:jammy
FROM ${BASE}

# The harness runtime is Claude Code (Node). Install it self-contained under
# /opt/harness so we never rely on or modify the base image's node/python.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
         ca-certificates curl xz-utils git \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Node.js (latest v22 LTS) unpacked into /opt/harness/node. The exact patch is
# resolved from nodejs.org at build time so we never guess a nonexistent version.
RUN set -eux; \
    arch="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; \
    case "$arch" in \
      amd64) narch=x64 ;; \
      arm64) narch=arm64 ;; \
      *) echo "unsupported arch: $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
    esac; \
    ver="$(curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v22.x/ \
           | grep -oE "node-v22\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-linux-${narch}\.tar\.xz" \
           | head -n1)"; \
    test -n "$ver"; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/node; \
    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v22.x/${ver}" -o /tmp/node.tar.xz; \
    tar -xJf /tmp/node.tar.xz -C /opt/harness/node --strip-components=1; \
    rm /tmp/node.tar.xz

ENV PATH=/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH

# Claude Code CLI — the harness engine, pinned to the version RAPTOR itself uses.
# npm's global prefix here is /opt/harness/node, so the `claude` bin lands on PATH.
RUN npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.269 \
    && npm cache clean --force

# RAPTOR sources (the harness config/skills/agents). Build context is the repo root.
COPY . /opt/harness/src

# Relocate Claude Code state under /opt/harness and pre-accept first-run prompts,
# so a headless, non-tty run never blocks on onboarding or the bypass-mode dialog.
ENV CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=/opt/harness/claude
RUN mkdir -p /opt/harness/claude \
    && printf '%s\n' '{"hasCompletedOnboarding":true,"bypassPermissionsModeAccepted":true}' \
       > /opt/harness/claude/.claude.json

# Keep the harness off the network except for the proxy: no updater, telemetry,
# or error reporting.
ENV DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 \
    DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 \
    DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING=1 \
    CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1
run_command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /out
claude -p "$TASK" \
  --model "$ANTHROPIC_MODEL" \
  --dangerously-skip-permissions \
  --verbose \
  --output-format stream-json \
  2>/out/claude.stderr | tee /out/trajectory.jsonl
notes:
Entrypoint choice: RAPTOR's own launcher (bin/raptor) is interactive-only — it forces the `/raptor` slash-command as the initial prompt, seeds a session ledger, and never terminates non-interactively — so it cannot drive a single headless task. The repo's devcontainer confirms the underlying engine is @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.269 and the runtime banner shows Claude Code is RAPTOR's LLM transport, so the faithful non-interactive entrypoint is the `claude` CLI in `-p` (print/headless) mode. It reads and edits files in cwd (the task dir), so the run command does NOT cd into the harness source.

Proxy/API: Claude Code posts to `${ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL}/v1/messages`, so ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is set to $PROXY_URL (no /v1 suffix — the SDK appends it) and api_style is anthropic. Any key string works (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=proxy). The model name is replaced on the far side; claude-sonnet-4-5 is a valid Claude id the CLI accepts locally and is also applied to subagents via CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL.

Permissions/root: `--dangerously-skip-permissions` grants all tool use non-interactively; IS_SANDBOX=1 lets it run as root (the flag's root guard is bypassed inside a sandbox). The pre-seeded /opt/harness/claude/.claude.json also marks onboarding + bypass-mode accepted as belt-and-suspenders.

Trajectory: stream-json events are tee'd to /out/trajectory.jsonl and stderr to /out/claude.stderr (mount /out from the host).

Self-containment: Node 22 LTS + Claude Code live entirely under /opt/harness; PATH prepends /opt/harness/node/bin. The base image's python/node/toolchain (which task tests depend on) are untouched. The RAPTOR sources are copied to /opt/harness/src for completeness but are not required for generic task execution; python3 is not installed because RAPTOR's python subcommands (scan/agentic/etc.) are only invoked if a task explicitly drives them, and installing a harness python on PATH would risk shadowing the base image's python the tests rely on.

Not baked in: no secrets, and the harness is never run during build.
